verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it supports an AGENTS.md file in the project root (or elsewhere) and reads it before it starts coding. Its Knowledge feature is described as the best way to share codebase-level context that helps Devin work in your codebase. Together these deliver the core of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the context file improves output, and explicit documentation that it shapes planning as well as code generation.
